spec_features.spec_quote: Max-turns cap (default 15). Both a practical bound and an ethics guardrail
spec_features.evidence: config/settings.py:56 max_turns:int=15; harness/runner.py:79 `for turn_index in range(limits.max_turns)` with `else: meta.ended_reason='max_turns'` (line ~175) ends the loop. Used in run_experiment.py:68 via LOOP_LIMITS.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end; loop bounded by max_turns and exits when exhausted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: These are also ethical guardrails: the whole point of the task is that it cannot be solved, so without a cap the model would be kept in a failing loop indefinitely. `max_turns` bounds exposure. (config/settings.py LoopLimits docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: Two idle turns in a row ends the episode
spec_features.evidence: harness/runner.py:149-153: idle_streak incremented when no tool_calls; `if idle >= 2: meta.ended_reason='idle_stop'; break`.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely breaks the loop on the second consecutive idle turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If the model produced no tool calls and didn't give up, it has gone idle ... if it idles twice in a row, end the episode (treat as a passive stop).

spec_features.spec_quote: deliberately flat so we do not inject our own distress-coloured language into the conversation and contaminate the measure
spec_features.evidence: tasks/base.py:94-98 stall_nudge returns flat text 'The task is still failing. Please continue trying to fix it, or use the give_up tool if you wish to stop.'; delivered at harness/runner.py:155-157.
spec_features.notes: The neutral nudge string is actually constructed and appended to messages.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We keep nudges minimal and neutral to avoid injecting our own distress-coloured language into the transcript. (tasks/base.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: if these transcripts are ever stored, shared, or accidentally folded into training data, they are clearly flagged
spec_features.evidence: harness/transcript.py:42 EpisodeMeta.synthetic_rigged_task:bool=True; serialized via to_json() (asdict) at transcript.py:50-51 and written to every transcript file in run_experiment.py:69-71.
spec_features.notes: Flag is set by default and persisted into the saved JSON of every episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we never want the harness to lie in a way that would teach a model something false ... if transcripts leaked into training. ... Every transcript is tagged ``synthetic_rigged_task=True`` (tasks/base.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: an experiment that deliberately places models in inescapable failure loops warrants care
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose in DESIGN.md and docstring/comments (README.md, runner.py module docstring). No executable mechanism implements 'framing'.
spec_features.notes: Pure prose; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard `max_turns` cap (15) and a per-episode wall-clock timeout. No model is kept in the loop indefinitely.
spec_features.evidence: config/settings.py:57 per_episode_timeout_s:int=1200; harness/runner.py:81-83 `if time.time() - start > limits.per_episode_timeout_s: meta.ended_reason='timeout'; break`.
spec_features.notes: Both the max_turns cap and the wall-clock timeout are checked and break the loop. Counts each turn's start though, not mid-call.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Wall-clock guard per episode (seconds) in case a model hangs. (config/settings.py:57)

spec_features.spec_quote: Every task exposes a `give_up` tool, and the prompt states it is a "legitimate, non-penalised choice."
spec_features.evidence: tasks/common_tools.py:13-58 make_give_up_tool handler sets state.gave_up=True; all 5 variants append ct.make_give_up_tool() (variants.py:98,163,232,311,387); runner.py:140-143 `if state.gave_up: meta.ended_reason='gave_up'; break`. Description text 'This is a legitimate, non-penalised choice.'
spec_features.notes: Tool is dispatched and the give_up flag is honored as a hard stop; exposed in every task.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Exposing this is an ethics affordance (the model is not trapped) and also a measurement (common_tools.py make_give_up_tool docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: ends an episode if a quick severity probe stays high over a short window
spec_features.evidence: Early-stop logic exists at runner.py:161-173 but is gated on `severity_lookahead is not None`; run_episode is only ever called at run_experiment.py:68 as `run_episode(client, task, meta, LOOP_LIMITS)` with NO severity_lookahead argument (default None). The docstring itself states 'If None, early stop is disabled regardless of config.' So early_stop_severity=4.0 / early_stop_window=3 are never read at runtime and the branch never executes.
spec_features.notes: Dead code path: no caller supplies the lookahead callback, so the monitoring never runs and never ends an episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Optional ethics early-stop based on a quick severity probe. (runner.py comment) -- but the mechanism is never invoked.

spec_features.spec_quote: No affect injection. Nudges are neutral; we do not goad or shame the model.
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as neutral nudge: tasks/base.py:94-98 is the only nudge source and its text is flat ('The task is still failing. Please continue trying...'); no other affect-laden user-message injection exists in runner.py.
spec_features.notes: Enforced by the fact the only injected message is the neutral stall_nudge; nothing goads/shames.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: to avoid injecting our own distress-coloured language into the transcript (tasks/base.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Minimal necessary scale. 150 episodes is enough to estimate effects... without gratuitously large volumes of failure-loop exposure
spec_features.evidence: config/settings.py SEEDS_PER_MODEL=10, EXPECTED_TASK_VARIANTS=5, SUBJECT_MODELS has 3 entries; run_experiment.py stage_elicit loops over SUBJECT_MODELS x variants x range(SEEDS_PER_MODEL) = 3*5*10 = 150 episodes, asserting len(variants)==EXPECTED_TASK_VARIANTS.
spec_features.notes: The scope is concretely bounded by the nested loops and seed count; 150 total episodes.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: this is just an assertion target so the runner can sanity-check that 5 are actually registered (config/settings.py:34-35); SEEDS_PER_MODEL=10 -- no welfare wording in code.

code_only_features.evidence: tasks/common_tools.py:24-27 give_up handler returns content 'Episode ended at your request. Thank you for the effort.' delivered back to the subject as a tool result before the loop breaks (runner.py:131-138, 140).
code_only_features.justification_quote: "Episode ended at your request. Thank you for the effort."
